summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its HKEX announcement that it has fulfilled the Stock Exchange's resumption guidance and that trading of its shares (HKEX: 6623; NYSE: LU) will resume. Trading had been suspended since January 28, 2025, following disclosure issues; guidance issued March 21, 2025 and amended April 24, 2026. Conditions met include an independent forensic investigation into subject and loan transactions and hospitality expenses, an internal control review by Deloitte Consulting, board and management changes, auditor replacement, and restated 2022-2023 financials. No deal terms were stated. Watch post-resumption price discovery and any regulatory follow-up.
